objective: Forecast next-season opportunity from role transitions and availability while preserving current skill rates; later test development separately

arms.name: A_BASELINE
arms.definition: Published 2027 v1.43; same per-origin replay for tests

arms.name: B_USAGE_TRANSITION
arms.definition: Historical usage-state transition model, with empirical participation and conditional workloads; no current chart, medical or external projection features

arms.name: C_CHART_CONTEXT
arms.definition: Condition opportunity on supplied current chart roles with explicit assumed availability/workload, preserving homegrown skills

arms.name: D_DEVELOPMENT
arms.definition: Component-specific age/experience adjustment; never jointly fitted with first opportunity test

chronology.player_history: Trailing four completed seasons for first test, matching baseline; latest-season and late-season role changes exposed explicitly. Any three-season variant is another prespecified arm, not a silent replacement.
chronology.fit: Strictly earlier training targets than each origin, maximum 2025; at least three supported scoring folds, no hyperparameter/feature search on their errors
chronology.cutoff: For November-26 forecasts, use prior-season data and role/evidence available by previous November 26; source-vintage limitations disclosed. Spring forecasts require a separate cutoff protocol.
chronology.year_2026: Only 2027 player-history/source audit after method/model freeze; no 2026 forecast errors for selection

hitter.equation: E[PA] = P(appearance) × sum_role P(role | appearance, prior information) × E[G × PA_per_G | role, appearance, prior information]. Model joint state/usage dependence; do not multiply unrelated marginal averages.
hitter.inputs: Prior observed workload, missing flags, late-season starting share and lineup slot after adapter validation, latest role transitions, position, disjoint minor workload, certified appearance history; age/experience only after audit
hitter.zero_rule: Unknown participation is not zero; certify target cohort before training appearance model
hitter.not_ready: No calibrated everyday/platoon classifier until historical game-start labels are validated

pitcher.equation: E[IP] = P(appearance) × sum_role P(role | appearance, prior information) × E[GS×IP_per_start + GR×IP_per_relief | role, appearance, prior information]. GS, GR and outing lengths are conditional joint quantities.
pitcher.inputs: Latest and late-season role, G/GS, reconstructed start/relief outs, recency and prior peaks of disjoint MLB/minor workloads, missingness and certified participation; chart inputs only in separate chart arm
pitcher.capacity: Empirical workload evidence and uncertainty, not automatic annual increases or an unvalidated universal IP cap. Injury risk is not inferred from a zero-season label.

estimation.status: Architecture specified; estimator settings must be frozen in an implementation contract before any scoring
estimation.first_candidate: Shrunk empirical state-transition probabilities plus conditional workload distributions estimated on earlier role/usage cohorts; back off to broader cohorts only when prespecified support is met, otherwise baseline fallback
estimation.distinction_from_rejected: Prior structured logistic/ridge starts-and-innings experiment remains rejected. New evidence is the validated recent role-state sequence and optional archived external role context, not a renamed reuse of its fit or coefficients.
estimation.training_support: Document class, cohort and conditional-outing counts before fitting. Retain prior workload support minima as floors where applicable; define any state-specific additional minima before scoring. No ad hoc sparse-state merges after viewing errors.
estimation.model_uncertainty: If calibrated probabilities are unavailable, publish conditional scenarios without scenario probabilities or advertised confidence intervals

team_constraints: For chart scenarios reconcile all player opportunity jointly to a declared team schedule, batting-order shares and pitching outs. Preserve replacement/depth residuals explicitly; do not give each starter a full season independently. Do not impose 1458 IP/team as an exact rule: actual team outs vary with home losses and extras.
coherence: Freeze supported homegrown skill components. Recompute AB and hit components/BB/HBP/SF/SH from coherent PA ratios; derive AVG/OBP/SLG/OPS. Pitcher counts use OUTS-based rates; derive IP/ERA/WHIP. GS/GR/G come from role model, not IP scaling. R/RBI/W/QS/SV/HLD require separately specified team/role rules or remain unavailable in scenario outputs; no assumed validated fantasy totals.
guards: Use unchanged existing workload gate and complete-projection/cohort safeguards, plus prior role/freshness protections. No automatic promotion; review largest player changes and coverage before adoption.
fallback: Unsupported identity, missing source role, sparse state, missing rate denominator or failed role gate retains full baseline vector in adopted output; exploratory scenarios remain separate. No baseline skill for a prospect/international arrival means no synthetic translated line.
implementation_sequence: Reconcile game-level labels and historical cohorts
Freeze executable usage-transition contract and support thresholds
Publish current C conditional scenarios separately if assumptions are explicitly registered
Acquire dated charts before historical C validation
Later test D development with DOB/age/experience audit
Review complete lines and exceptions before any adoption
